protocol.split: 75/25 GroupShuffleSplit; named fraud-ring members share a group; ungrouped merchants are individual groups
protocol.graph_features: Recomputed separately per seed using only that split's training labels and temporal prior edges
protocol.evaluation: All models use the same Travel test query per seed; cold_start_query is the zero-transaction subset
protocol.maml: First-order MAML; held-out-category support comes from training only; threshold maximizes support-set F1; support rows are excluded from test query
